title: Seven Wild Sawfish Had a Mother but No Father. DNA Proved It
subject: smalltooth sawfish

scenes.text: Seven wild fish had a mother, but no father. DNA proved it.
Scientists in Florida checked 190 tagged smalltooth sawfish, and found seven pups carrying only their mother's genes.
That is called a virgin birth, and it was the first time anyone found one in the wild shark family.
About three percent of the sawfish they studied were born this way, and all seven pups looked perfectly healthy.
Scientists think it may be a backup plan when mates are scarce, and these fish are critically endangered.
So a fish with a saw on its face can sometimes have babies with no father at all.

description:
Seven wild sawfish had a mother but no father.
A 2015 study found virgin births in wild smalltooth sawfish in Florida, about 3 percent of the fish studied.
How many other animals could do this in secret?
